why: Each mutation re-spells one wired deadline call site back into its literal, which is exactly the defect this law names: a message authored at a call site instead of resolved as a KEY from PREVIEW_DEADLINE_MESSAGE_KEYS.  Every mutated site was wired on 2026-10-10, so each expect is the real occurrence count of the wired expression in the current tree - if a future refactor moves a call site, a count pin will drift and this red arm will refuse to apply rather than silently measuring nothing.  The two LivePlayerPopup sites are identical text, so ONE mutation with expect=2 reverts both.
measured: post-wiring tree, 2026-10-10; CRLF normalised to LF the way the checker reads it
